ja: 金曜まで、彼女は返信しなかった。
en: Not until Friday did she reply.
alternatives: Only on Friday did she reply.
She didn't reply until Friday.
point: Not until を前に出すと did she reply の倒置

ja: 皆で決めた日が私は心配だ。
en: The date everyone agreed on troubles me.
alternatives: I'm troubled by the date everyone chose.
The agreed date worries me.
point: agreed on で具体的な日について合意する。

ja: 君の懸念で私は旅行を再考中。
en: Your reservations have me second-guessing the trip.
alternatives: Your doubts have me reconsidering the trip.
Your misgivings have me questioning the trip.
point: reservation はここでは懸念、second-guess は判断を疑い直す。

ja: まだ何も予定を立ててないよ。
en: I haven't made any plans yet.
alternatives: I haven't planned anything yet.
I still haven't made any plans.
point: まだ〜ないは yet と現在完了

ja: 約束してなきゃ、家にいるのに。
en: If I hadn't promised, I'd be home.
alternatives: If I hadn't made plans, I'd be home now.
I'd be home now if I hadn't promised.
point: 過去の仮定 had + 今の結果 would be

ja: 雨が降ったら、中止だよ。
en: If it rains, it's canceled.
alternatives: It's canceled if it rains.
If it rains, we'll cancel.
point: if 節は現在形。canceled は米式の綴り

ja: 食事会、金曜になったよ。
en: The dinner was moved to Friday.
alternatives: The dinner has been moved to Friday.
The dinner got moved to Friday.
point: 変更された、は was moved

ja: 直前のキャンセルでごめんね。
en: Sorry to cancel at the last minute.
alternatives: I'm sorry to cancel at the last minute.
Sorry to bail at the last minute.
point: 謝る理由は Sorry to + 動詞

ja: 我々が断ってたら大失敗を免れてた。
en: Had we declined, we'd have dodged disaster.
alternatives: If we'd refused, we would've avoided disaster.
We'd have avoided disaster if we'd declined.
point: Had we は過去の仮定、dodge disaster は惨事を免れる。

ja: 私は再会が楽しみ。
en: I'm excited about our reunion.
alternatives: I look forward to our reunion.
I'm eager for our reunion.
point: look forward to の to の後には名詞や動名詞。

ja: 今週末はひまだよ。
en: I'm free this weekend.
alternatives: I'm not busy this weekend.
I'm available this weekend.
point: 「ひま」は free。this weekend に前置詞は不要

ja: 何時に集合しようか？
en: What time should we meet?
alternatives: What time shall we meet?
What time do you want to meet?
point: 時刻は What time で始める

ja: 来週のほうが都合がいいよ。
en: Next week works better.
alternatives: Next week works better for me.
Next week is better for me.
point: 「〜のほうが」は比較級 better

ja: その日は忙しいんだ。
en: I'm busy that day.
alternatives: I'm booked that day.
I'm tied up that day.
point: that day に前置詞は不要

ja: 土曜日に来てね。
en: Come on Saturday.
alternatives: Come over Saturday.
Please come on Saturday.
point: 曜日の前は on。命令文は動詞から

ja: 映画を見に行こう。
en: Let's see a movie.
alternatives: Let's go see a movie.
Let's go to a movie.
point: 誘うときは Let's + 動詞の原形

ja: 彼女、来られるといいな。
en: I hope she can come.
alternatives: I hope she can make it.
I hope she'll be able to come.
point: hope の後ろの that は省ける

ja: 彼女は予定を見て誘いを断った。
en: Checking her calendar, she declined.
alternatives: She checked her calendar and declined.
After checking her calendar, she declined.
point: 先にした動作は -ing で文頭に置ける

ja: 私が時間を決めるよ。
en: I'll choose the time.
alternatives: I'll pick the time.
I'll decide on a time.
point: will はその場で引き受ける意思にも使う。

ja: 早く言ってくれればよかったのに。
en: You could have told me sooner.
alternatives: You should have told me sooner.
You might have told me sooner.
point: 「〜できたのに」は could have + 過去分詞

ja: 私は予定の中止を考えてる。
en: I'm considering scrapping our plans.
alternatives: I'm thinking about abandoning our plans.
I'm considering calling off our plans.
point: scrap は計画を取りやめて白紙に戻す。

ja: 私は家族と予定を調整する。
en: I'll coordinate plans with my family.
alternatives: I'll work out plans with my family.
I'll arrange plans with my family.
point: coordinate は複数人の予定を調整する。

ja: 彼はいつも私たちを待たせる。
en: He always makes us wait.
alternatives: He always keeps us waiting.
He's always making us wait.
point: make + 人 + 原形で「〜させる」

ja: 彼女が条件を変え続ける理由分かる？
en: Know why she keeps moving the goalposts?
alternatives: Do you know why she keeps changing the conditions?
Any idea why she continually changes the requirements?
point: move the goalposts は途中で条件を変える。

ja: 行けないなら教えてね。
en: Tell me if you can't.
alternatives: Let me know if you can't.
Please tell me if you can't.
point: if 節の中は現在形。can't のあとは省略できる

ja: 土曜は行けないんだ。
en: I can't make it Saturday.
alternatives: I can't come on Saturday.
I can't go on Saturday.
point: 予定に「行ける」は can make it でも言える

ja: 友達が予定を変えたんだ。
en: My friend changed plans.
alternatives: My friend changed the plan.
A friend of mine changed plans.
point: change plans は複数形。特定の予定なら the plan

ja: 私に都合がいいのは金曜だよ。
en: It's Friday that works best for me.
alternatives: Friday is the day that works best for me.
It's Friday that suits me best.
point: It's 〜 that 節で「金曜こそ」を強調

ja: 私、空気を読んでおけばよかった。
en: I wish I'd read the room.
alternatives: I wish I'd picked up on everyone's mood.
If only I'd sensed how everyone felt.
point: read the room は場の雰囲気や相手の気持ちを察する。

ja: その時はもう皆帰っていた。
en: Everyone had left by then.
alternatives: Everyone had already gone by then.
Everyone had gone home by then.
point: 過去より前のことは had ＋ 過去分詞

ja: 旅行を計画したんだ。
en: I planned a trip.
alternatives: I planned a vacation.
I organized a trip.
point: 過去の出来事は動詞を過去形に

ja: 彼女は誰が水を差すか知らないかも。
en: I doubt she knows who's playing spoilsport.
alternatives: I'm not sure she knows who is spoiling things.
She may not know who is ruining the fun.
point: spoilsport は人の楽しみに水を差す人。

ja: 駅前のカフェでいいよ。
en: The café by the station works.
alternatives: The café near the station is fine.
The café by the station is okay.
point: 名詞の後ろに前置詞句を置いて説明する

ja: 病気しなかったら、今ごろ行けたのに。
en: If I hadn't gotten sick, I'd be there now.
alternatives: If I hadn't fallen ill, I'd be there now.
If I hadn't been sick, I'd be there now.
point: 過去の仮定 had + 今の結果 would be

ja: 彼女は金曜は望み薄だと言った。
en: She said Friday was a long shot.
alternatives: She said Friday was unlikely to work.
She said Friday had little chance of working.
point: a long shot は実現する見込みが低いこと。

ja: 時間があれば、行くのに。
en: If I had time, I'd go.
alternatives: I'd go if I had time.
If I had the time, I would go.
point: 現実と違う仮定は If + 過去形、would

ja: 日程がかち合ってる。
en: There's a scheduling clash.
alternatives: The schedules clash.
The schedules conflict.
point: a scheduling clash は日程が重なること。

ja: うちは空いた週末などめったにない。
en: Rarely do we get a free weekend.
alternatives: Seldom do we have a free weekend.
We rarely get a free weekend.
point: Rarely を前に出すと do we get の倒置

ja: 私は代替の予定を残したい。
en: I want to keep a fallback.
alternatives: I'd like to keep a backup plan.
I want to retain an alternative plan.
point: fallback は予定が無理なときに使える代案。

ja: その約束、金曜に延期できる？
en: Can we push it back to Friday?
alternatives: Can we put it off until Friday?
Could we reschedule for Friday?
point: 「延期する」は push back / put off

ja: 私は最後通告を誘いと呼びかねる。
en: I'd hesitate to call ultimatums invitations.
alternatives: I'd be reluctant to call ultimatums invitations.
I'd balk at calling ultimatums invitations.
point: hesitate to で断定を控える、ultimatum は最後通告。

ja: 表向き任意でもこの外出は強制に感じる。
en: Though ostensibly optional, this outing feels coercive.
alternatives: Though supposedly optional, this outing feels forced.
Despite being nominally optional, this outing feels coercive.
point: ostensibly は表向きには、coercive は強制的な。

ja: 私は皆の週末の予定を詰めてる。
en: I'm sorting out our weekend plans.
alternatives: I'm finalizing our weekend plans.
I'm working out our weekend plans.
point: sort out は予定を整理して決める。

ja: もう彼には行けないと伝えたよ。
en: I've already told him I can't come.
alternatives: I've already let him know I can't come.
I already told him I can't make it.
point: 「もう〜した」は現在完了 + already

ja: 私は君に決めてほしい。
en: I want you to decide.
alternatives: I'd like you to decide.
I want you to choose.
point: want + 人 + to で相手にしてほしいことを言う。

ja: 急かされ私は日取りを確定した。
en: Pressed, I nailed down a date.
alternatives: Under pressure, I finalized a date.
Feeling rushed, I fixed a date.
point: nail down は日取りを曖昧なままにせず確定する。

ja: 彼女は旅行をずっと決めかねてる。
en: She's been vacillating over the trip.
alternatives: She's been wavering about the trip.
She's been unable to decide about the trip.
point: vacillate は決められず気持ちが揺れ動く。

ja: 私たち、決めなきゃ。
en: We have to decide.
alternatives: We need to decide.
We must decide.
point: 「〜しなきゃ」は have to

ja: 我々は金曜を仮予定にしていい？
en: Could we pencil in Friday?
alternatives: Can we tentatively schedule Friday?
Can we put Friday down provisionally?
point: pencil in は変更の余地を残して予定に入れる。

ja: 話してた旅行、なくなったよ。
en: The trip we discussed fell through.
alternatives: The trip we talked about fell through.
The trip we were talking about fell through.
point: that を省いた関係詞節で名詞を修飾
